verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications: In thy faithfulness answer me, and in thy righteousness.

segments.text: Hear my prayer, O Jehovah; give ear to my supplications:
In thy faithfulness answer me,
and
in thy righteousness.

verses.text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant; For in thy sight no man living is righteous.

segments.text: And enter not into judgment with thy servant;
For in thy sight no man living is righteous.

verses.text: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath smitten my life down to the ground: He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

segments.text: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul;
He hath smitten my life down to the ground:
He hath made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.

verses.text: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; My heart within me is desolate.

segments.text: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me;
My heart within me is desolate.

verses.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy doings; I muse on the work of thy hands.

segments.text: I remember the days of old;
I meditate on all thy doings;
I muse on the work of thy hands.

verses.text: I spread forth my hands unto thee: My soul thirsteth after thee, as a weary land. [Selah

verses.text: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth: Hide not thy face from me, Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.

segments.text: Make haste to answer me, O Jehovah; my spirit faileth:
Hide not thy face from me,

verses.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; For in thee do I trust: Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; For I lift up my soul unto thee.

segments.text: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning;

verses.text: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

segments.text: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from mine enemies:

verses.text: Teach me to do thy will; For thou art my God: Thy Spirit is good; Lead me in the land of uprightness.

segments.text: Teach me to do thy will;

verses.text: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name’s sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

segments.text: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name’s sake:
In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.text: And in thy lovingkindness cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that afflict my soul; For I am thy servant.
